segments.speaker: Rep. Arnan C. Panaligan
segments.text: Madam Speaker, the parliamentary status of House Bill 10858 is that it is in the period of debate. I now move to consider the proposed budget of the Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Any objection? The Chair hears none. The period of sponsorship, debate and interpellation on the proposed budget of the Office of the President is hereby opened. Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnan C. Panaligan
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move to proceed with interpellations on the proposed budget of the Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: May we request the Majority Leader to recognize the sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnan C. Panaligan
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I acknowledge the presence of the officers from the Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnan C. Panaligan
segments.text: Led by former Secretary of Finance, former Senator and former House Deputy Speaker, Executive Secretary Ralph Recto. Senior Deputy Executive Secretary [unclear]. Deputy Executive Secretary for Finance and Administration [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnan C. Panaligan
segments.text: Deputy Executive Secretary for Legal Affairs [unclear]. Deputy Executive Secretary for General Administration [unclear]. Deputy Executive Secretary for Support Services and Auxiliaries [unclear]. Director General Maria Helen de la Vega. Executive Director Danilo [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnan C. Panaligan
segments.text: Undersecretary [unclear]. Undersecretary Georgina [unclear]. Undersecretary Erwin Santa Ana. Undersecretary Leonardo Roy Cervantes. Assistant Executive Secretary [unclear].

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: To the Office of the President family headed by

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: our Executive Secretary, the Honorable Ralph Recto, our mentor and our light for several years in legislation, welcome to your and our House of the People.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnan C. Panaligan
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move to recognize also my brother Representative

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnan C. Panaligan
segments.text: to answer questions on the proposed budget of the Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: To sponsor the proposed budget of the Office of the President, the Senior Vice Chair of the Committee on Appropriations, the Hon. Abet Garcia of the 2nd District of Bataan, is hereby recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much, Madam Speaker, Majority Floor Leader, Distinguished Guests and Colleagues. Magandang umaga po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: On behalf of the Committee on Appropriations, I have the honor to sponsor the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget of the Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: The Office of the President is the apex of the executive branch, the office from which the President as Chief Executive and Commander-in-Chief directs the entire government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: We appropriate for the working of the presidency itself.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: The 2027 budget, the office proposes a 10,155,758,000 or 10.16 billion inclusive of the retirement and life insurance premium.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: That is about 0.14% of the 7.2 trillion national budget, roughly one-seventh of 1%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: For the highest office of the land, this is a lean proposal, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: By allotment class, it is an operating budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Operating expense account for 7.46 billion or 74%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Personal services comprise of 1.86 billion or 18%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Capital outlay stands at 839.66 million or a mere 8%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: By source, it is almost entirely new appropriations at 99.29%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: General administration and support at 2.74 billion and operations at 7.41 billion delivered through four programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: The largest is the Presidential Oversight Program at 5.37 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Public assistance and performance monitoring across the executive.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Next is the Executive Staff Service at 1.63 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Covering the President's missions and state visits.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: and the Legal and Legislative Services Program at 180 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: The latter funds the review of the very bills we pass.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And the office binds itself to account for every peso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Under its special provision, it must file quarterly reports on its financial and physical accomplishments within 30 days of each quarter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Post them online and notify both houses and their committees on appropriations and finance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Transparency here is not a promise, it is a condition of the appropriation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Now to what my colleagues will notice at once and what I present with pride, not apology, on a comparable basis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: The office's budget falls from 28.03 billion to 10.08 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And that is a reduction of 17.95 billion, or 64.02%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: The Office of the President is asking for

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: The reason is plain. Some P17.55 billion of that drop is the completion of the locally funded projects in 2026 budget, principally our hosting of the ASEAN 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: That duty is successfully done. Not a single peso of it is carried in the 2027 budget. And even setting ASEAN aside, the regular programs were trimmed by a further 392.52 million or 3.75%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: This is an office that tightened its own belt before asking our people or any agency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Madam Speaker, this is a budget that funds the presidency at a fraction of the national total, carried an unchanged workforce, bound to quarterly transparency, and smaller than the year before.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: I stand ready, together with the resource person headed by our Executive Secretary, Ralph Recto, to answer any questions in this chamber.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: With that, I respectfully sponsor and commend the fiscal year 2027 budget of the Office of the President and move for its favorable consideration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Madam Speaker, maraming salamat at magandang umaga po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move to recognize the Honorable Rene Co. of the Kabataan Party List to interpolate the sponsor.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The Honorable Rene Co. is hereby recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Speaker. At magandang umaga po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Will the distinguished sponsor yield to a few questions in relation to the budget of the Office of the President?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Yes, Madam Speaker. At magandang umaga po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, ang ating mga katanungan dito ay mga natanong na rin natin over the course of the budget cycle.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ngunit sa mga paglalatag ng mga...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: mandato, the Office of the President would be in the best position to answer these questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang una nating tanong ay patungkol po sa Barangay Development Program to support the

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: activities of the National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict or NTF-ELCAC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Bilang chairman ng NTF-ELCAC ang Pangulo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Alam ba ng Pangulo kung ano ang proseso ng pagpapaklear ng mga barangay para maging

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: eligible beneficiaries ng Barangay Development Program?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maari po bang madetali, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, yung proseso na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Well, one of the major process, Madam Speaker, ito po'y dumadaan sa mga local peace and

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: development councils from the LGU up to the region at umakit po ito sa National Peace

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And ito po ang nagde-declare ng insurgency-free sa ating mga localities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And kapag ito po'y nadeclare na insurgency-free, they would be eligible for the fund under

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: the LGSF or yung Barangay Development Program, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, tinanong po kasi natin sa DILG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Bilang sila po yung nagkukulit ng listahan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Bilang sila po yung tumatanggap ng listahan at later sila ang magbibigay ng pondo or

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: mag-aalat ng pondo sa NEP para mabigay ng grant yung nasa loob ng program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang sabi po nila, Barangays undergo community support programs and retooled community support

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At ang listahan, pagka natapos na...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pagka natapos na yung sumisyon na ito, ay i-e-endorso ng NTF-LCAC to DBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So ang tanong natin, Madam Speaker, good sponsor, ito lang ba ang requirement para maging eligible?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Automatically, in-e-endorse lang din ba ng NTF-LCAC kung ano mang mga listahan yung makarating sa kanila?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ano pong mga iba't-ibang proseso para ma-verify na kung ano man po yung nakalagay sa listahan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: kung ano pong activity yung nangyayari?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Sa mga local peace councils ay naisagawa po. Madam Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Sa mga local peace and order council, Madam Speaker, distinguished colleagues,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: kasama po dito ang armed forces, PNP, and other agencies,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: and they validate in context itong mga insurgency clearance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Bukod po dyan, yung ating mga peace and order councils is chaired by the mayors, the governors,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And once, together with the armed forces, these localities are validated as insurgency-free,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: they will be eligible for the Barangay Development Program assistance, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, from the ground up po ito, at kapag na-validate po ito from the ground up,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: dun pa lang po umaakyat sa ating NDFL-CAC, and they refer this to DBM and DILG

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: para po maging eligible dito po sa Barangay Development Program Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor. Ano pong ibig sabihin ng in context, validated in context?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maari po bang makapaglatag ng isang senaryo na nasabi ng AFD?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: PNP, PNP, other agencies do that kind of validation habang, ano po, pag ginagawa po yung activity?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Yeah. What I mean, Madam Speaker, na in context, kasi it's very hard for the national government

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: or the national level to validate yung pagiging insurgency-free ng isang lugar

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: from the macro level or the national level.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, the people on the ground know the situation best.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And these are the local government officials, the mayors, the barangay officials,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: together with the national agencies in that locality.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Yan po ang ibig sabihin kong in context, and they would know more the situation on the ground.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And when they refer this, and after validation from the region and the national,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: dun po sila eligible for the Barangay Development Program assistance, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang narinig ko pa rin, Madam Speaker, is that the local government officials, the mayors, the barangay officials,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, gusto rin po natin sanang maging maspecific kung paano po ito nagagawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At paano po nasasabi, Madam Speaker, good sponsor, na insurgency-free ang isang barangay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At ano pong involvement ng mga pambansang ahensya na nasabi nga po ng ating good sponsor

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ay naroon sa isang lokalidad para masabi, ma-verify, ma-validate na insurgency-free

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Anong beyond signatures and assents ang ginagawa para masabi pong insurgency-free?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Let me get the exact parameters, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Maintain po natin yung exact parameters, pero ang concern ng kinatawan na ito ay baka auto-approval.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Dahil po kung auto-approval yan, standing po rin po yung critique natin, na nilatag natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: matagal na, na pwede po ang mga ahensya na may tungkulin na maglatag ng mga kalsada,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: magpondo, magtayo ng mga paaralan, doon na lang po pumunta ang pera na nilalaan sa barangay development program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: That way, hindi po nagkakabuhol-buhol yung mga mandato ng mga ahensya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Ito po yung ating mga parameters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: First, all the barangays that were completed with...

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: the CSP, or Community Support Program, operation has been subjected to the Retooled Community Support Program, or RCSP, of the DILG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: All barangays that were completed with the RCSP has been a beneficiary of the barangay development program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Integrated Territorial Defense System, or ITDS, are established and functional.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Peace and Order and Public Safety Plan, a three-year term-based plan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: which covers activities that address peace and order and public safety issues in the local government unit, is implemented.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleagues, these are some of the parameters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: These are some of the parameters that our drug-cleared LGUs undergo, and this is the process, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, gusto po natin i-clarify, ano po itong three-year term-based plan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Paano po ito nilalatag sa lokal, at paano po siya ina-actualize?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May bahagi po ng sagot, Madam Speaker, good sponsor, ang nailatag na ng DILG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: In particular, yung pagkakaroon nga po ng community support programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At sa pagsailalim ng barangay, ay masasabing, o sige, cleared na sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero kaya nga po yung tanong natin remains, ano ba yung community support program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: beyond, pagtapos ng pagpasok ay, after ba nito, ay masasama na sila sa listahan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, iba't-ibang paraan para makita na dapat sila yung target, at even, naging successful yung BSP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero Madam Speaker, good sponsor, ang tanong po natin ay yung three-year term-based plan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Yung three-year term-based plan, ang nagpo-formulate po nito ay yung Barangay Development Council.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Again, in context, because context matters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Gustong tahakin na development plan and peace and order plan nung barangay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, headed by the chairman and the community of the barangay, not just the officials,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: sila po magpo-formulate ng plano na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And once formulated, ito po yung sinusuportahan ng ating barangay development program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, it may vary for each barangay, pero ang maganda po rito, sila mismo ang gumagawa

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At ito po yung sinusuportahan ng LGU plus the national government through the barangay development program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, ikaklarify ko lang po, iba pa po ito ba sa peace and order and public safety plans

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Kasama po ito, and this is required and monitored.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, may iba pa, aside from POPs? Madam Speaker, good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Because the development of a certain barangay is not only determined by the peace and order,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: but also by the economic and social development of the barangay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, it is a holistic approach.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Nang sa ganun, ay umangat na po at maging...

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Tuloy-tuloy na po ang pagiging insurgency-free nitong mga subject barangays.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Speaker, good sponsor, aware po kasi tayo na may DILG Memorandum 2020-118

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: na ang concern na tinanong natin sa DILG ay kung ipe-peruse po natin yung document,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: yung sentro ng gawain ng local peace and order councils,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: at even ng mga POPs plan ay focus po ang anti-illegal drugs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So, ngayon, gusto nating malaman kung sa anong parameters masasama yung insurgency-free,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: kung actually, yung mga plano po ng POPs ay nakasentro sa a different matter completely.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I have been a former mayor, a former governor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Intertwined po sa peace and order, ang drugs, which is 90% of all the crimes committed in our country,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At itong dalawang bagay na ito ay napaka-importante na ating maresolba sa granular level,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: like the barangay, nang sa ganon, after we do this,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: unti-unti na pong umangat itong mga nasabing barangay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: kaya maaaring mga pagtatawag o mga mag-exitement assistance that will come in.

segments.text: SARO is a, you know, transmission of SARO is a mere administrative function na hindi ito tulad ng pamimigay ng ayuda, pero parang ganun ang lumalabas ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At malinaw na po yung pag-question natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yes, last night sa DILG, sa alokasyon na meron mga ilang pinagpalang LGU, 500 million or more ang natatanggap, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: The city of Manila got a significant share.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: More than 500 million, as was seen earlier, yung Naga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Even the city of Lipa, Batangas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 500 million for a multipurpose building, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Samantala, all the vast majority of LGSF, particular FALGU recipients, natatanggap nila 30 million and below.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano ba ang kriteriya nito and who decides?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: That's why we say this is highly discretionary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: I also don't believe in presidential pork.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kung sinong malapit sa kusina, eka nga, yun ang makakatanggap ng malaki.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ngayon, ano po ang papel ng Office of the President sa pag-decide kung sino ang makakatanggap at magkano sa mga LGU para dito sa LGSF na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: First of all, ito pong LGSF is part of the General Appropriations Act which we passed as being having the power of the purse.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, ine-execute lang ito ng executive headed by our president ang pag-distribute nito according to the guidelines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: This is implemented by the DBM pero demand-driven po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: May portal at dun po nag-a-apply yung iba't ibang LGU all around the country para humingi po o mag-request ng assistance sa local government support fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And also, this is supported by jurisprudence ng mga Supreme Court decision na constitutional, sinasabing constitutional, ang local government support fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, the executive is merely implementing the...

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: ...budget which was passed by both houses of Congress.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: In implementing, kailangan pa rin pong sundin ng Office of the President ang batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At ano po ang umiiral na batas?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ...administrative code, let me read, that this is section 6, book 5, section 35, I hope I remember that correctly, of the administrative code on special budgets for lump sum appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, this applies to all lump sum appropriations including...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, sorry, chapter 5, section 35 of the administrative code.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Expenditures from lump sum appropriations authorized for any purpose or for any department, office, or agency in any annual general appropriations act or other act and from any fund of the national government shall be made in accordance with the special budget to be approved by the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: To be approved by the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, yung mga releases po sa LGSF, is it in accordance with section 35, approved by the President?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleagues, the executive is implementing the LGSF the way the legislative approved it through the general appropriations act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, that is the legal basis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: The legal basis for the LGSF followed by the DBM circular, which they passed, medyo makapal nga yun, Madam Speaker, distinguished colleagues, with regards to the implementation of the local government support fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay, let me just, so I take that as a no.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Hindi po sinusunod itong section 35, kundi daw yung GAA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Let me just note that nowhere in the GAA does it explicitly repeal or amend.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, in other words, hindi pwedeng ma-circumvent yung presidential approval, which, let me note, kaya nandyan yan, is precisely it is a safeguard against abuse of lump sum funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kaya po nagre-require ng approval ng Presidente, eh dahil kayo po ang magche-check kung walang abuso dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, okay, noted po na mukhang hindi nyo sinusunod ang section 35.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Let me move on, dahil paubos na ang ating oras.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: In this very hall, alam natin, 2025 zona, nagsabi ang Pangulo, mahiya naman kayo, at dyan na nagsimula yung investigasyon sa flood control corruption.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: The cabinet members have been promoting the line, notably Secretary Vince Dizon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa kanyang mga interview, sabi niya, according to news reports, si dating House Speaker na ang tinutukoy na biggest fish sa ngayon, ayon kay DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, yun ang linya ngayon ng palasyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ayan na, meron na tayong nakulog.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: The biggest fish is already arrested.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sabi naman ni Senator Lacson, Marcos' critics should be silent.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: After the arrest of the former speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Parang ang script, ayan na ang biggest fish, tigil na natin, tapos na, we can move on, nandyan na yung biggest fish.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero nandyan na nga ba? What about the President himself?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Let me quote an important speech made by Senator Lacson.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At the time he was still chair of the Blue Ribbon Committee, Senate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Now, Yusek Trigiv-Olaivar, other personalities, anyway, regarding the 100 billion, being raked down kasi, ni-review niya yung kanyang notes.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: With the indulgence of Honorable Tino, please proceed to your question and please wind up.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: I am, this is my last question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: This is all related even to the appointment of Secretary Recto to be the Executive Secretary as he is now the acting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: I guess acting kasi hindi naman pwede maibigay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang interim appointment because Congress is not in recess, diba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, okay. Anyway, ang sabi niya sa akin, hindi po totoo yan, Mr. Senator.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kasi ang breakdown ng 100 billion, 81 billion yung na-assign sa DPWH, yung 29 billion other agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Hindi niya alam, out of the 81 billion or out of the 100 billion, yung sa 81 billion, 52 billion siya ang personal na nag-handle.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa notes niya, ito yung kanyang table.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Binigyan niya na ako ng kopya, 51.01, I think, almost 52 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Anyway, sa 52 billion, yun yung personally hinandle niya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang talagang sabi niya, naghatid ako ng pera as kickback, but not to the President, but to Yusef Olaybar.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang sabi niya, ang pagkakaalam niya, kasama si Adrian Bersamin, 8 billion pesos, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: With the indulgence of the Honorable Tino.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Honorable Tino, please proceed to your question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: The modus that day, yung arrangement nila is may tig-isa silang armored van, may armored van si Yusef Olaybar, may armored van siya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Magpa-park sa basement ng Diamond Hotel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Darating yung van driven by Olaybar and possibly, sabi niya, hindi siya sigurado, and possibly along with Adrian Bersamin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ipa-park, idadrive yung isang van na puno ng pera.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: What is your question so the sponsor can respond?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Umabot sa 2 billion only because sometime in March, yung kanyang dati na sinabi from I think March hanggang April yung delivery.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Anyway, ang sinabi ay, but personally he knows or he knew that kasi personally amounting to 8 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 1 billion he delivered to Secretary Punoan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung 8 billion was representative of 16 percent of the 81 billion.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Thank you very much, Congressman Tino.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Please go direct to the point.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: What is your question so the sponsor can answer?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang usapan daw nila initially was 15 percent for the President.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Madam Speaker, the sponsor may respond please.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Madam Speaker, ang tanong na po ay pagkatapos ng revelation nito on the records of the official records,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: the Senate in plenary delivered by Senator Lacson alleging na ganyan ang impormasyon na binigay ni Yusek Bernardo

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: na nag-deliver siya, may tinrabaho siyang 51 billion na insertions for the President

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: with a 16 percent kickback of 8 billion delivered through Yusek's Olaivar and Bersamin to the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And after this, sinibak mo sa pwesto si Executive Secretary Bersamin,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Pasensya na po, Congressman Tino, what is your question?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Please go direct to the point because we have other interpellators online.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Bakit hanggang ngayon ay wala pa pong opisyal na paliwanag kung ba't sila sinibak at walang anumang investigasyon na pinapagawa ang Office of the President sa mga opisyal na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Yes, Madam Speaker, if I may.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Congressman Tino, please let the sponsor respond.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The Honorable Abet Garcia is recognized.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The question is, are there investigations being conducted?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: First of all, yung mga detalye po na nabanggit ng ating kasama, hindi po aware ang Office of the President with regards to those details.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And with regards to investigation, yes, there are a lot of investigations being done.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: By the Blue Ribbon Committee, by the Ombudsman, by the DOJ, at tuloy-tuloy po ang paggulong ng ating Pustisya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: In fact, ang dami na pong nakakulong ngayon, our former Speaker, Senator Jingoy, Senator Bong Revilla, Curly and Sara Diskaya, J.P. Mendoza, Roma Rimando, Henry Alcantara, Roberto Bernardo, Sally Santos,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, gumagulong po ang Pustisya sa ating bansa, Madam Speaker, distinguished colleagues.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: Maraming salamat, distinguished sponsor. Maraming salamat, Congressman Tino. Your time is up.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Speaker. Tapos na po ang aking interpellation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Let me just note that in the transcript as well, sabi dito, the President received the handwritten narration of Bernardo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ngunit hindi pa rin iniimbestigahan ng mga aligasyon dahil involved siya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, hindi pa po tapos ang paghahanap at pagpapanagot sa biggest fish ng flood control corruption scandal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move to recognize the Honorable Egay Erice from the 2nd District of Caloocan to interpellate the sponsor.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The Honorable Egay Erice of the 2nd District of Caloocan City is hereby recognized for a very brief interpellation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Good morning to our Majority Leader and our sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Madam Speaker, Mr. Chair, I recognize the proposed 10 billion budget of the Office of the President may be justified.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: And that it represents a substantial reduction from its 2026 allocation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: The reduction is as much as 64%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: And I think with our problem in the West Philippine Sea,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: a 4 billion intelligence fund, confidential fund is justified.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: But my question concerns the policies that the President will pursue with approximately 21 months left before June 30.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So, may kasabihan tayong all's well that ends well.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Kaya ang pangunahing tanong ko po, paano balak ng administrasyon na matapos ng maayos

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: ang administrasyon at maiayos po ang gumabagal nating ekonomiya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Nais ko na rin pong samantalay ng pagkakataon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Kung papaano po ang balak ng ating Pangulo upang iangat ang public spending, upang umangat ang ating ekonomiya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Ganon din po kung ano ang mga hakbang na gagawin para bumaba po yung ating inflation, which is about 6%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Ganon din po yung lumalaki nating pambansang utang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So, kung paano po ang pagkakataon, siguro baka naman po may plano tayo kung paano natin medyo papagaanin ang pag-utang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: As I know that for the 2027 budget, we are about to borrow 1.69 trillion just to add another 1.6 trillion

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: para po sa ating mga maturing loans.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Para po mapadali, sabihin ko na po lahat ng aking mga katanungan, then maybe you can answer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Pagdating naman po sa reforms, sa reform agenda ng ating pamahalaan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: parang may nararamdaman po akong pushback doon sa pinangako ng ating Pangulo tungkol sa Kadena Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Ano po ba ang plano dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Ating administrasyon, ganoon din po sa alalabas lang na desisyon ng Korte Suprema

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: kung paano po irarali ng ating Pangulo ang anyang mga kaalyado sa Kongreso

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: para mapadali ang pagpapasa ng Anti-Political Dynasty Law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: marami pong ginagawa ang ating Pangulo para umangat po yung ating ekonomiya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And of course, number one dito, yung pinaka-importanting legislation na ating ginagawa taon-taon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: which is the timely and quality passage of our budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Ang laki ng tulong po nito para sa government spending on time by the turn of the year,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: nang sa ganoon ay lalo pang umangat ang ating GDP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At the same time, nakita naman po natin na napaka-busy po ng ating Pangulo

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: in trying to attract foreign direct investment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Nung isang linggo, nasa India po siya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And there were commitments made by big businesses in India to invest in the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Kahapon, nakita po natin yung trade agreement signed by our Secretary of DTI with the EU,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: which is, if I'm not mistaken, the third biggest economy in the world.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At mukhang susunod pa po ang isa pang trade agreement with Canada.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, sa North America naman po, ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, aside from government spending and attraction of foreign direct investment,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: hopefully, pag malampasan po natin itong energy crisis na ating pinagdadaanan

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: at ginagawan din po ng paraan ng ating Pangulo para maibsan itong crisis na ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: hopefully, tumaas na po at manumbalik yung sigla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And the Office of the President is confident with the timely passage of this budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: babalik na tayo dun sa ating trajectory nung normal growth natin before the crisis began,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And this will, of course, create a lot of jobs and opportunities for our country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: With regards to the management of our debt,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: pababa po ng pababa ang ating debt to GDP ratio.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, from 5.6 last year to 5.4 this year,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, pababa po yung deficit to GDP ratio.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And we will maintain this trajectory para bumaba nang bumaba yung ratio.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And because of that, Madam Speaker, Honorable Colleague,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: by 2028, bababa na rin po yung debt to GDP ratio.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Yung pong reform agenda natin, yung kadena.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: With regards to the Kadena Act, sinimula na po ng BBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Kung napapansin po ninyo yung kanyang programang entitled COMPASS,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: or Centralized Open Monitoring Platform for Appropriation and Spending Statistics.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Ito po yung nasa website ng BBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At nakita po po ito personally.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: para makita po natin yung spending ng ating gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And this is the first step to Kadena.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Because once we digitalize, we now have the speed of light.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Kumbaga, kahit sino pwede mag-download, pwede natin i-apply ang AI dito to analyze.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: At kapag napasa na po ng both houses of Congress ang Kadena Act,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: mas madali pong i-plug in dahil digitalize na po ang spending ng ating gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: And this is my point, Mr. Speaker, that there's a pending bill in the House and the Senate regarding the Kadena Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So, ito po ba ay idideklara na urgent ng ating Pangulo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Yes. The position of the President, he is supportive of this legislation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: In fact, Madam Speaker, Honorable Colleague,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: nasa ledak po itong legislation na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Kasama po siya sa isa, sa priority, legislative, executive priorities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Naipasa na rin po yung anti-political dynasty version ng House

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: at naipasa na rin po sa second reading, ang sa Senate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So, may balak po ba ang Pangulo na maideclare na urgent ang anti-political dynasty?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: I am quoting our Executive Secretary na he would like to take this opportunity

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: to address the House of Representatives and the Senate to pass this legislation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: The President is very supportive of this bill.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: basura, trapiko, pabahay at land use ang naguugnay na problema sa Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: 36% po ng GDP natin galing dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: At kailangan-kailangan pong mabigyan ng solusyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: Bukas po ba ang Pangulo na supportahan ng isang elected Metropolitan Manila Government

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: sa ilalim ng Article 10, Section 11 ng ating Constitution

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So, na lumika ng Special Metropolitan Political Subdivision

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: nasa sa ilalim sa isang plebisito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: ang ating Executive Secretary have not discussed this particular issue with the President,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: pero according to our ES, he thinks this is a good idea.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: In this case, in behalf of the minority,

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So, to terminate the discussion on the budget of the Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleagues, good morning.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: It is an honor and privilege to sponsor the proposed 2.62 billion budget of the Presidential Communications Office

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: and its attached agencies and corporations for fiscal year 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: As the lead communications arm of the government,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: the PCO plays a vital role in ensuring that the Filipino people receive timely, accurate, accessible,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: and responsible information on government policies, programs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: We have the lowest budget and the last department-level agency of the Executive Department in terms of budgetary allocation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: PCO may have the least budget priority, but they assure your honors that they are up to the Herculean task of engaging and involving the citizenry and the mass media in enriching the quality of public discourse on all matters of governance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: This function is essential to good governance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Government programs can serve the public only when citizens understand what assistance is available, how to access it, why policies are being adopted, and how public institutions may be held accountable.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Clear communication, therefore, connects policy with public service, supports participation, and helps sustain trust between the government and the people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: even more significant at a time when social media is woven into everyday life.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: Information now reaches millions within seconds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: But so do misinformation, disinformation, manipulated content, and AI-generated material.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: The PCO must be present where people receive and exchange information,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: not merely to broadcast official messages, but to communicate

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: quickly, clearly, credibly, and responsibly across digital, broadcast, and community platforms.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: The proposed budget will support the PCO and its attached agencies and corporations in fulfilling their respective mandates and strengthening government communication across various platforms.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alexandria "Queenie" Gonzales
segments.text: In view of the foregoing, I respectfully urge our distinguished colleagues to support the approval of the proposed PCO budget for fiscal year 2027.

segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Madam Sponsor, para sa mga estudyanteng galing sa geographically isolated or low-income communities, tuition may already be covered pero ang transportation, boarding, pagkain, books, and connectivity remain major expenses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. Mr. Speaker, distinguished colleagues, I rise today to sponsor the proposed fiscal year 2027 budgets of our state universities and colleges.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Across the country, including the University of the Philippines system. At the outset, Mr. Speaker, I acknowledge my fellow sponsors who will help defend SUC budgets in their respective areas: Representative Arthur Celeste for Luzon, Representative Emer Lollipop [unclear] and Representative Karl Nicolas [unclear] for the Visayas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: And Representative Bernadette Barbers and Representative [unclear] for SUCs in Mindanao. I thank our co-sponsors for taking on this responsibility and helping ensure the concerns and requirements of our state universities and colleges across the country are represented before this House. It is a particular honor for me to stand here on behalf of my own alma mater, the University of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: But today we speak not only for one university or one region. Together we speak for the students of our state universities and colleges from Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao, young Filipinos who look to public higher education as their pathway to a better life. Para sa maraming pamilyang Pilipino, ang makapasok sa isang pampublikong unibersidad ay higit pa sa pagtanggap ng diploma. Ito ay pagkakataon na makapagtapos para sa kanilang kinabukasan at sa kinabukasan ng kanilang mga pamilya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Sa bawat pintuang binubuksan ng ating mga SUCs, may pamilyang nabibigyan ng pagkakataong mangarap nang mas malaki. Iyan ang pangakong dala ng ating mga SUCs. Under the proposed fiscal year 2027 national budget, our state universities and colleges are allocated 141.09 billion, an increase of 6.1 billion or 4.5% compared with the fiscal year 2026 National Expenditure Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Funding for the Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education program is likewise being increased as more Filipino students enter our public universities. But our responsibility does not end with opening the doors of our universities. Access must come with quality. As enrollment grows, our SUCs must have enough teachers, classrooms, laboratories, equipment, and learning resources.

segments.text: So, these projects po have already started.
