segments.text: Naintindihan natin, sabihin nila, hindi naman pwedeng pareho lang nung

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 2026 ang capital outlay. One time yan eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, pero meron pong narinig tayo na a number of SUCs, zero pa nga ang capital outlay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ilang state universities ang walang capital outlay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Based on the data submitted sa data sa binigay ng PASOK,

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: nasa 12 po, 12 ang SUCs na wala pong capital outlay sa kanilang...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 12 SUCs. Pwede po ba natin marinig for the record?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sino yung 12 SUCs na walang capital outlay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: At pinapadagdag din po ng ating PASOK na...

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Ano po, tumaas pa ang numero, nasa 25 po na SUCs ang walang infrastructure projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: So, yung kanina pong 12, ayun po ay ano lang yun, no capital outlay allocation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Opo, tama po yun, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, maaring may capital outlay pero hindi infrastructure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yun ang ibig sabihin nun. Okay. Para marinig lang natin, sino yung 12 na yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Para nasa record at para mabantayan natin kung magkakaroon pa rin ba.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: O, sige. Gusto sana natin ilagay sa record. Pero, sige na po. Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pahingi na lang, nung listahan ng 12 and the 25 na binabanggit ninyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: para ma-follow up din natin, mabantayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Alam natin may ongoing na programa para makapag-hire ng...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: However, let us take a look at faculty items.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Dahil po sa free higher education, naturally, lumalaki ang enrollment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At naturally, kailangan mo ng mas maraming teachers, faculty.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero, hindi naman po nagdadagdag ng new items.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Therefore, job order and contract of service faculty.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang mga faculty na job order and contract of service.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: nasa 55,000 po ang ating mga job order and contract of service workers

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: na kabilang po sa part-time faculty ng ating mga SUCs sa buong Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, 55,000 job order. Lahat yan, faculty. Tama po. Is that correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Sama na po yung teaching and non-teaching items po dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Teaching and non-teaching. Well, pwede po bang mabigyan tayo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Mukhang wala kayong datos. Ilan dito yung teaching, ilan yung non-teaching?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Sa lukuyin po, wala pong current breakdown.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Ang informasyon po na binigyan ng PASOK, 26,000 po ang teaching positions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Na ano po, na job order.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay, 26,000. Ayan po, malinaw na malinaw ah.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 26,000 faculty or teaching positions na job order or contract of service.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, tutulak din po natin na mabigyan ng bagong items,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang mga state universities and colleges,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: where 9,000 items were created and distributed to the state universities and colleges.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kahit pa pano, at the time, that was one-third of the requirement.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, kahit pa pano, nakatulong. Hopefully, magawa uli natin ngayong taon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: I actually already made this point during the interpolation of CHED, the CHED budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: However, gusto po natin marinig ito ng ating mga state universities and colleges,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: and for the record, in plenary as well,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: yung babalikan ko yung advokasya natin ngayon, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ng injustice to instructor one position.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung mga instructor one position natin sa state universities and colleges.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Magiging instructor one ka lang with plantilla item kung ikaw ay merong MA or MS.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Subalit, sa SUCs, ang merong MA or MS na instructor one, salary grade 12 lang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Samantala, sa ibang mga ahensya ng gubernator,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: sa ibang mga ahensya ng gobyerno, notably sa DEPED,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: guidance counselor, MA requirement, salary grade 16.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Master teacher one, MA requirement, salary grade 18.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Alam ko sa UP, nakikita ko si Chancellor Vistan eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung mga MA holder nila, assistant professor yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Salary grade 18, assistant professor ang title pag may MA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero sa mga ibang SUCs, sa ating 112 other SUCs ay salary grade 12.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So panahon na po para iwas to, itama ang napakatinding injusticia na to.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So bakit, katulad ng nabanggit ko kanina, kung ikaw ay nurse,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: wala kang MA, registered nurse, mag-apply ka sa government hospital, salary grade 15 ka.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero pag mag-apply ka sa SUC, sa College of Nursing, para magturo, kailangan may MA ka.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Meron ka ng MA, tinanggap ka, instructor 1, salary grade 12 ka.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So maling-mali, panahon na para iwas to, may commitment ang CHED.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Dahil nilatag na po natin ang problema, hinarap na natin sa Kongreso at sa mga ahensya na concerned.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: CHED, Civil Service Commission, DBM at Kongreso, kailangan iwas to na po natin ang injusticia na to.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, nag-commit ang CHED na kagyat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Harapin nila ang DBM at Civil Service Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So we expect that this will be acted upon soon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ibig po sabihin yan, pag tinaas natin yung instructor 1 to salary grade 16,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: eh dapat po, pati yung ibang mga posisyon, necessarily, kailangan tumaas din.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Dahil deserve ng mga faculty ang mas mataas na posisyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At po, ay biktima ng inyustisyang ito, dapat harapin na natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ibigay natin sa ating mga faculty ang deserve nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pinagtrabahuhan nyo ang inyong professional qualifications, dapat sweldohan kayo ng tama.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, sinusuportan po ba ng sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pagwasto natin sa salary grade ng mga instructor 1?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Ah, kasama nyo po kami sa pagsusulong po ng pagpapataas po ng kanilang salary grade.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: At, ah, bilang pong anak ng isang teacher, ah, ako rin po ay, ah, ano po, sangayon po sa inyong pinapanukala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Maraming salamat po, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Hanggang doon na lamang po ang aking interpellation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I move that you recognize the Honorable Reneco, I mean, Sara Elago, for her interpellation.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin
segments.text: The Honorable Sara Elago of, ah, Gabriela Partilis is hereby recognized for her interpellation. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang representasyon po na ito mula sa Gabriela Women's Party ay sumusuporta din sa panawagan na dapat pondohan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ng kongresong ito, ang pagtitiyak na mapupunan ang deficiency sa pondo para sa free higher education na nasa 5.3 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At pangalawa, yung pagre-restore ng pondo ng mga state universities and colleges, lalong-lalong na po sa maintenance and other operating expenses,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: napakahalaga po niyan para sa pagmementina at pagtitiyak na tuloy-tuloy na maayos ang operation ng activities,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ating mga SUCs. Pangatlo, ang nais ko na lang pong amhingin

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: mula sa ating SUCs ay report na may kinalaman sa kanilang

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: compliance sa gender and development mandate. Nakita po

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kasi natin mula sa ulat ng CHED na nasa 72% lang ng mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: state universities and colleges natin ang nagko-comply sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: pangangailangan at nararapat na pagkakaroon ng Committee on

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Decorum and Investigation na fully funksyonal. Gayun din

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang pagtitiyak na may mga offices na dudulog at didinig ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: mga kaso na may kinalaman sa paglabag sa Anti-Sexual

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Harassment Act at sa Bawal Bastos Law. Malaki ang concern

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: natin dito, Madam Sponsor, dahil matagal na po nabatas yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Anti-Sexual Harassment Act mula 1995, nagulat po tayo na meron

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung mga SUCs na wala pang maayos na CODI na fully funksyonal

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at pangalawa pagdating sa Bawal Bastos Law, dapat sa visa ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: pagkakaroon din ng tulak ng CHED Memorandum Order para sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: pagpapatupad ng Bawal Bastos Law ay nakarating na po ito at

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: napapatupad sa lahat ng ating state universities and colleges.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ayan na lang po ang ating hihingin mula sa ating Distinguished

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sponsor at sa ating mga state universities and colleges at ang

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: natin pong representasyon ay handa rin naman na magbuo ng mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: espasyo sa pakikipagtulungan. Halimbawa, sa Philippine Commission on

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Women, sila po ay may mandato na magbigay ng mga capacity building,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: institutional development programs para tumulong sa compliance sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Magna Carta of Women at lahat po ng mga batas na may kinalaman, hindi lang

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa kababaihan, kundi po sa pagkamit ng tunay na mainstreaming

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at integration ng gender and development sa paggamit ng at least 5% na pondo

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ng ating mga state universities and colleges. Maasahan po ba natin mula sa ating

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Distinguished Sponsor na titiyakin natin ang submission ng report tungkol sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: GAD compliance ng lahat ng SUCs?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker, our Distinguished Colleague. Nangako po ang CHED na sila po ay magbigay po ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: kasama po ang pasok ng impormasyon po ukol sa mga GAD activities po at

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: completion na kanilang, GAD compliance po na kanilang ang mga datos po na mayroon sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: At yung lingkod din po, patuloy din po ang aming suporta sa ating GAD initiatives

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: para po mas malawig po ang compliance ito sa CHED.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: At mga SUCs naman po natin ay batay po sa pag-relay po ng ating pasok president

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: ay generally compliant po sa mga GAD activities at nina-nice po nila na ipakita po yung report

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: ng lahat po ng kanilang mga SUCs ukol sa usapin po ng GAD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Speaker. May nakuha rin po tayong output mula sa PCW.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Tungkol sa 2024 GAD utilization at nasabi nga po dito na sa state universities and colleges,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: nasa 6% naman yung spending nila para sa GAD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngunit nung sinilip po natin yung mga specificong aktividad kung saan po ito ginagastos,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: marami pa rin ay halimbawa may kinalaman po sa observance ng 18-day campaign to end violence against women

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nandiyan din po ang tungkol sa selebrasyon natin ng National Women's Month

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at nakita po natin na nananatili pa rin na separate from all other major programs ng SUCs ang ating GAD spending.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya ho, nararapat din na magkaroon tayo ng tuloy-tuloy na capacity building, institutional development,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: yung focus sa organization mismo within the state universities and colleges.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dalawang klase po kasi yan na maaari natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung isa po ay nakafocus mismo sa organization ng ating mga SUCs at yung isa naman na maaari po na pagkagastusan

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ay nakatoon naman dun sa mismong stakeholders, ang constituency, at maaari din through extension services ng ating mga SUCs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yun po ang nais nating makita, natiyak ng mga activities, integration, hindi separation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: makakatulong ho ang pinakahuling ulat ng SUCs para dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, Mr. Speaker, nabanggit din po ng ating kasamahan kanina,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: si Representative Perci Cendaña, yung tungkol po sa insidente sa Batangas State University.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maaari po ba kayong magbigay ng update kung may ginawa ng aksyon ang BATSU tungkol dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nakita ko rin po dun sa pinakahuling ulat ng PCW na ang Batangas State University po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang number one pagdating sa total GAD allocation sa fiscal year 2024.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maaari po ba natin matiyak na pagdating dito sa GAD spending,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang programa po natin nakatoon din dun sa mga gender-inclusive na mga policies

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at itiyakin po natin na hindi na mauulit ang kahit anong mga insidente na meron pong mga kaso ng diskriminasyon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: o kaya nakakaramdam po ng hindi pagsali sa mga palisya ang ating mga estudyante.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi lang ito para sa estudyante ginawang speaker, ginawang sponsor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: pero para rin sa ating faculty members, sa ating mga non-teaching personnel,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: napakahalaga po na pag may ganitong kaso, hindi natin papayagan na muling mangyari sa ating mga campuses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Yes, to our distinguished colleague, ang presidente po ng Batangas State University,

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Hindi na po mauulit ang mga ganitong insidente at asahan nyo daw po na ang kanilang mga polisya po patungkol sa GAD

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: ay patuloy po nila ipapatupad at siguraduhin po na hanggang sa baba po sa implementation level

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: ay hindi po magkakaroon ng hindi pagkakaunawa, hindi po malino na pagkakaintindi ang mga nag-implement po nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: At base po sa kanilang pinakahuling report ay ongoing na po yung administrative proceedings po patungkol doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Sa mga nabanggit po ng mga security guard po na allegedly sila po ang naging sanhi po ng itong mga gender-based mga violations

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: at patuloy po nilang ipapatupad po ang kanilang mga polisya patungkol po sa GAD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, nakalagay din sa CHED Memorandum Order na dapat tiyakin ang ating SUCs,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ng lahat ng ating HEIs at sa ngayon nga po sa ating State University and Colleges,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: merong konsultasyon pagdating sa mga estudyante, faculty, sa ating education stakeholders,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang lahat po ng mga polisya na hindi lang gender-sensitive pero nakalagay din po doon disability-sensitive,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: yung mga policies natin towards inclusion, dapat may konsultasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maasahan po ba natin ito sa ating mga State Universities and Colleges?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Ah, ano po, pinapangako po nila

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: na yung konsultasyon po na ito, hindi lamang po sa mga estudyante,

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: kundi pati po sa mga kanilang magulang at pati na rin po sa mga guro na mga kasama po sa pamantasan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat kayo noong Speaker at sa akin din pong kananasan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang halimbawa na integrate po yung GAD mandate sa orientation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: pag-offer ng mga gender-sensitivity trainings para sa mga org na nagpaparegister,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa kanilang mga campuses, sa kanilang mga eskwelahan, sa hiring ng faculty, non-teaching personnel,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: lahat po yan, dapat po sa lahat ng level ng ating pamantasan ay may ganitong tipo ng tuloy-tuloy na training at capacity building.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At nakikita ko po dito, Philippine Normal University, isa din po sa mga pinakaaktibo na nagtitrain,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: hindi lang po sa ating mga kapwa-SUCs, pero sa iba't-ibang mga sektor,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: maaari silang makaabot para po sa tunay na inklusibo na edukasyon sa lahat ng antas ng ating sistema ng edukasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya po, ganun din sa University of the Philippines, meron pong Diliman Gender Office,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: merong Office on Anti-Sexual Harassment, ang kanila pong OWASH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yun po yung hangad natin na sana makita din.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sigurado po ako, marami pang SUCs na may ganun tipo ng mga focal systems,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ganun tipo ng mga spesipiko na mga centers at offices,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at hangad natin gano'ng speaker na dapat may pondo ang lahat ng ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya muli, dapat ma-restore yung mga MOOE budget cuts ng ating mga state universities and colleges.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Gayun din po, dapat pag-aralan ng kapulungan na ito kung paano pa tataasan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: yung nailaan na capital outlay budget para sa ating mga SUCs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: May hirapan po tayong magawa yung mandato sa universal access to quality tertiary education

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kung hindi po sasabay na papalawakin din yung capacity ng mga SUCs na tumanggap ng mas maraming mga scholar ng bayan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: mas maraming mga faculty members na nagiging regular at nagkakaroon ng security of tenure sa kanilang mga trabaho.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung tuloy-tuloy ang pagdaltas ng kanilang pondo at kung hindi natin dadagdagan ang kanilang pondo para sa capital outlay at personal services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat gano'ng speaker. Maraming salamat, distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Thank you, the Honorable Elago, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rhea Mae A. Gullas
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we recognize the Honorable Dada Kiram Ismula for her interpellation.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: The Honorable Dada Kiram Ismula, a portalist, Akbayan is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: As-salamu alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: I just have a few general questions addressed to all our SUCs. Una, in accordance with the Higher Education Modernization Act, ano ang compliance rate of our SUCs on the inclusion of students' councils or students' regents in the Board of Regents or Board of Trustees?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Meron ba sa mga SUCs natin ang non-compliant pa rin dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Colleague, ano po, ang 100% po ang compliance rate na ni-report po ng ating pasok sa ating mga state universities and colleges?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, maaari bang maibigay ng ating mga SUCs ang compliance rate nila sa creation of committees?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: on Decorum and Investigation, o CODI, to investigate sexual harassment cases in accordance with the Safe Spaces Act. Meron ba na as of now ay non-compliant pa rin dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Sa ngayon po, sila po ay nag-report na sila po ay generally compliant. Pero sila po ay willing magbigay po ng impormasyon po sa inyong tanggapan

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: patungkol po sa mga detalye po ng bawat state universities and colleges po patungkol po sa kanilang compliance po sa inyong hinihingi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, this representation would like to request a compliance report from our SUCs on how they are implementing provisions

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: supporting students with disabilities and priority for poor families under the Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Can our SUCs provide this report before the second reading of the GAB?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Before po on second reading, they will be able to furnish you a copy po. They have the data po and they will be very much willing po to provide you along with the earlier request po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, can the SUCs also commit to provide a report on the enrollment rate, dropout rate, and performance of students from the indigenous people sector?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Ang CHED po ay may informasyon po patungkol po diyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: At sila rin po ay mag-furnish po ng copy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Copy sa inyong tanggapan po patungkol sa mga dropout rates po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kanina po, during the CHED budget deliberation, naitanong ko rin po ito at inomit din po ng CHED na magbibigay din po sila ng datos na to

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: dahil ongoing pa nga daw po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At last year, nag-commit din ang CHED na magre-release sila ng memorandum sa mga SUCs na patungkol dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kaya naman po, naitanong din natin ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At hihintayin po ng aking opisina ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, how do our SUCs ensure that they are compliant with CHED Memorandum Order No. 2, Series of 2019,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: which requires the integration of IP studies?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Meron bang available na data ang mga SUCs showing compliance to this memorandum?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Mula po ng tanggap po ng ating mga SUCs and CHED Memorandum No. 2 po patungkol nga po sa mga IPs natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: At sila naman po ay nagkaroon ng, sila po ay nabigyan ng payo po na mag-observe po ng compliance po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Kasama na po yung mga application po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: kasama po ng mga indigenous communities sa kanilang mga application po sa ating mga SUCs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, distinguished sponsor, I would look forward to all the data I have requested from our SUCs

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: before we proceed with the second reading of our House Bill No. 10858.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Sa inyo po yan, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, Mr. Sponsor, regarding naman po sa capital outlays,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ng Polytechnic University of the Philippines o PUP,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: from our consultation with the students of the PUP,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: 2 to 3 years delayed na ang north wing building ng PUP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: However, sa COA report, may 106 million pesos unreleased capital outlay for 2025.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Can you illustrate paano i-utilize ang north wing building?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: base po sa update, the PUP north wing project is being implemented by DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: So the funds were directly given to DPWH by the national government under our General Appropriations Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: So the unreleased capital outlay for 2025 is still with the DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: They were able to acquire 164 million funding under the 2026 budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: And they were able to bid out the project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: And the DPWH was able to...

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: And as of now po, they still need...

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Ang ano po, there was actually a failure of bidding.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: At hindi po na-implement ang project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: And kinakailangan pa po nila ng 500 million to complete the 9-story building.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Ang plano po nila dun sa 9-story building,

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: it will have classrooms for classes and students in the main campus po of PUP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, ang status po ng...

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: construction ng north wing building ay hindi pa nasisimulan dahil sa failure of bidding.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Tama po. Failure of bidding po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ano po kaya yung naging rason kung bakit hindi rin na-release yung capital outlay budget para rito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Dahil din po ba sa failure of bidding?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Hindi po sila, ang administrasyon po ng PUP ay hindi po na bigyang linaw po ng DPWH

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: dahil po yung failure of bidding ay nangyari po sa ahensya po ng DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Hindi po nakabilang ang PUP po sa implementation po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sige po. Ito na lang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Can the PUP commit na makipagpo-operate, makipagpo-ordinate sa DPWH

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: nang sa gayon ay makomplete na po ang construction ng north wing building?

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Patuloy po ang pakipag-ugnayan po ng PUP sa DPWH para po sa pagkompleto po nitong building na ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: at they will commit po to coordinate with DPWH

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: at patuloy po ang pagbigay ng update sa ating sa kongreso patukol po sa paggawa ng building.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: At nais din po nalang ibigay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Linaw po, biging ulat na nakipagpulong na daw po sila sa tanggapan po ng Office of the Secretary ng DPWH,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Siguro ang kulang na lang po ay i-update po natin ang mga estudyante po natin no.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Dahil itong katanungan ay pinaabot po nila during our consultation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Anyway, Mr. Speaker, I would like to use my remaining time on the floor to make an important manifestation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: na iulat na 43% ng ating state universities and colleges ay humaharap sa budget cuts para sa susunod na taon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ang paliwanag ng DBM ay mas mataas pa rin ang budget para sa 2027 kung ikukumpara sa NEP to NEP basis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, hindi lamang administrators at faculty ang nag-aalala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: at kabataan natin ay malinaw na nagpapahayag ng kanilang concern.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Nararamdaman nila na anumang pagbawas o kakulangan sa budget ay direktang tatama sa kanilang access sa quality education,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: sa kanilang scholarships, at sa kanilang oportunidad na makapagtapos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: In this regard, I manifest my full support for increasing the budget of SUCs for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Strengthening our state universities and colleges means strengthening the future of our youth and the nation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: With adequate funding, SUCs can continue to expand access to education, sustain research and innovation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: and provide the necessary support for faculty and students.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: With this support for an increase, I urge our SUCs to assure the House of Representatives

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: that they will ensure the participation of students, teachers, and staff in the governance of their universities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: I urge our SUCs to assure the House of Representatives that they will ensure our students,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: no matter what your SOGI-SC, are protected from sexual harassment in the safe spaces of our schools and universities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: That administrators and professors who are found liable for sexual violence are removed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: That the students, staffs, and teachers are supported when they want to file a case

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: instead of sweeping the issue under the rug to preserve the reputation of the university.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: With this support for an increase, I urge our SUCs na gawin ng lahat

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: para masigurong ang mga katutubo, mga probinsya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: at paano mga maralita at iba pang mga nangangailangan sa mga mahihirap na pamilya

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ay mabigyan ng prioridad sa free tuition.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Para naman masabi din nila, pwede nang mangarap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Speaker. Maraming salamat, Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: so yun po yung sagot namin

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ay sana po ay makapagbigay po

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Just on the part of DOE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Kaya po hinihingi na natin yung guya, yung guide na gusto pong i-release ng DOE in relation sa kung paano tutugunan itong malaking konsumo ng kuryente na inaasahan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So as a final manifestation na lang po on this, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, sa patuloy nating pagtatanong sa iba't ibang ahensya ukol sa feasibility at sustainability ng Paxilica, nabubunyag natin yung mga iba't ibang incompatibilities nito with the existing capacities, whether it is on land, on water, and also here on electricity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mayroong mga nagsasabi na tayuan nila ng sariling power supply.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero ang sa atin, bakit po hindi natin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Hindi na lang tayo mag-focus sa pag-improve ng existing power systems natin para tugunan yung demand na kinakailangan ng ngayong latag ng mga households na hindi kaya as of now and nagiging result nito ay ang mga rotating brownouts.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Danas sa mga iba't ibang regyon, ang rotational brownouts na hanggang ngayon ay hindi pa rin po nasa solusyonan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We cannot say with confidence that there is a solution.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We cannot say with confidence that there is a solution to the DOE crisis when communities continue to face power interruptions at i-entertain pa natin itong Paxilica initiative na may napakalaking iniasahang konsumo ng kuryente.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So sa atin, Mr. Speaker, Gunsponsor, this representation urges the DOE to essentially also provide its recommendations kung ano po ba ang priorities na dapat tugunan when it comes to usaping energy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Hindi po sa pag-fund sa Paxilica, pero dito po sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ...immediate needs of households para po ma-power yung kanilang mga kabahayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker, we totally agree with Congresswoman Reneco.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: That's why ang policy po ng DOE is they have to generate their own power.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Tayo po ay para sa ating mga kababayan, sa mga consumers, sa mga negosyante, sa industries.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But regarding Paxilica, if they come in, they have to generate their own power.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Siguro, last clarification na lang po, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Gunsponsor, when we say they have to generate their own power, will they be independent from the Luzon Grid?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So hindi sila ma-integrate sa Luzon Grid?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Kailangan po nila magtayo ng sarili ng GENCO.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Okay. So ibig sabihin may sarili rin silang grid, tas i-coordinate na lang nila yung mga ibang-ibang requirements sa DOE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, off-grid po siya. Direkta na po doon sa kunsang site magtatayong Paxilica.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Wala po sila sa grid natin, off-grid po yung tawag doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: At kung ganito po, maasahan ba natin na hindi maapektuhan yung supply ng power kuryente ng Luzon Grid?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Definitely, Mr. Speaker, dahil nga po off-grid. So hindi po siya dadaan sa main highway po natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Ang susunod pong topic na lang natin, and this will just be a manifestation, na pansin natin yung policy on waste to energy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Na hindi lang po ng Department of Energy, pero pati ang ibang-ibang ahensya din po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And once again, this representation would like to take this opportunity to once again voice out its opposition sa pag...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Hindi lang intensify ng waste to energy facility building, pero yung pagbuo ng framework, lalo na inaasahan din na bibenepisyo din ito sa TAG as Renewable Energy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Hindi malayo na gawing alternative energy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Of course, ang mga WTE facilities, even with yung sinasabing Pax Silica Hub and yung plans nito, maaaring ma-factor in po dito ang waste to energy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Pero, Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, malubha na ang kalagayan ng ating kalikasan, ang pag-i-entertain ng waste to energy facilities on top of yung in-entertain nating Pax Silica Initiative,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ay mas makakasira pa po nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Because, at the end of the day, WTE facilities will only contribute to the larger environment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Environmental destruction happening around the world, whether it is by encouraging the continuous creation of goods,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: dahil at the end of the day, kung ano mang waste yan, ito ay...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: It will just be burnt, no? For energy's sake.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And hindi po yung mas... other alternative frameworks, even when we say circular economy or even yung zero waste policy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Nonetheless, Mr. Speaker, this representation is firm in its stance against WTE facilities in the country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: To that, I no longer have any questions to our distinguished sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: We thank the sponsor for answering our questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And of course, hintayin po natin yung mga ulat na nirequest through the sponsor to the Department of Energy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And I'm committed na once natapos po yung guidebook, even sa Pax Silica, we will furnish you the copy, Mr. Speaker.
