segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move that we recognize Representative Sara Jane Ilago from Gabriela Women's Party Party List.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: The Honorable Sara Jane Ilago from Party List Gabriela Women's Party is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, sa ilalim ng Republic Act No. 12316, binigyan ng Pangulo ng kapangyarihang magsuspinde o magbawas ng excise tax sa petroleum products kapag ang average ng Dubai crude oil price ay umabot o lumagpas na sa $80

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kada bariles. Ang rekomendasyon ay manggagaling sa DBCC in coordination sa DOE. Maaari po ba nating malaman kung ano ba ang naging rekomendasyon ng DOE sa DBCC? Lalong-lalo na po ngayon sunod-sunod ang oil price hikes. Noong September 22 lamang nagpatupad na naman ng panibagong malaking oil price hike.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kada litro sa diesel nasa 6.47, sa kerosene 4.88, sa gasolina [unclear]. Ayon mismo sa DOE, ito na ang ikatlong sunod na malaking oil price increase ngayong Setyembre. Kung pagsasamahin po natin ang tatlong magkakasunod na oil price hikes ngayong buwan, umabot na sa [unclear] sa diesel lamang, nasa 16.67 sa kerosene at 15.25 sa gasolina.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa ngayon, umaabot na sa nasa 104 kada litro ang presyo ng diesel at 87 kada litro naman sa gasolina. Ano po ang rekomendasyon ng DOE hinggil dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Just to clarify, Mr. Speaker, ang trabaho po ng DOE ay only to submit the certification sa DBCC na nag-over na po tayo sa $80 per barrel. But it is up to the DBCC to act on it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Wala na po sa kapangyarihan ng DOE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, malinaw po naabot o lumagpas na doon sa trigger na presyo. May certification na rin mula sa DOE. Ang kinakailangan na lang po ay agarang aksyon sa pagpapababa sana po ng presyo ng petroleum products. At kahapon lamang naglabas ng anunsyo ang DOF na sususpendihin po ang excise

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: taxes sa LPG at kerosene. Naniniwala po ba ang DOE na nararapat din na maisama na ang pagsuspende ng excise tax sa diesel at gasolina? Lalong-lalo na po ngayong araw nagsimula na rin ang strike ng ating mga jeepney drivers at iba pang public utility drivers. Nananawagan na rin ang mga provincial at city bus drivers, operators at kanilang mga kumpanya na dapat mas malawak na aksyon para pababain ang presyo ng langis sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes. As much as we want to answer, Mr. Speaker, wala na po kasi sa mandato ng DOE. It's up to the economic managers to decide. Mahirap pong sumaklaw sa kapangyarihan na hindi nakapaloob sa Department of Energy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, good sponsor, kailangan po sanang busisiin natin yung naipasa nating batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kasi po nanggaling din dito ang Department of Agriculture at ang posisyon po nila, hindi nga lang pagsususpende, pagbabawas ng excise taxes sa petroleum products. Ang panawagan nila, maski po yung 12% value-added tax sa petroleum products, lalong-lalo na po sa crudo na ginagamit ng maraming mangingisda at magsasaka, ay dapat meron nang aksyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nandiyan din ang mga nabanggit kong jeepney drivers, operators, companies na nananawagan ng dagliang aksyon. Ang sinasabi po sa atin, hindi lang ng DOE kundi ng iba pang departamento, DOF ang dapat kalampagin pagdating sa agarang rekomendasyon para sa aksyon ng Malacañang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Napakalayo po ng DOF doon sa mga pinakaapektadong sektor ng pagtaas ng presyo ng langis: drivers, manggagawa, magsasaka at mangingisda. Nababahala tayo na baka maulit ang nakita natin noong unang kwarto ng taon, kung saan LPG at kerosene lang ang agarang aksyon pero hindi ang parehong urgency para sa diesel at gasolina.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nais ko ring magtanong sa DOE: meron po ba tayong inaasahang dagdag-singil sa susunod na linggo o buwan? Ano ang prospects ng presyo ng langis? Nakikita po ba natin ang pagbaba o pagtaas at paano po tayo naghahanda dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Well, that depends on the international market.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Wala po tayong control diyan. Pag tumaas sa international market, sigurado pong tataas. Pag bumaba, sigurado rin pong [unclear].

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Muli, Ginoong Speaker, ginoong sponsor, dito sa kapulungan na ito kasalukuyan na rin tayong nag-aaral ng mga amyenda sa kaugnay na batas para matiyak na hindi tayo nakaasa lamang sa ini-import na langis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dito mismo sa ating bansa, palakasin ang kakayahan na mag-supply sa kinakailangang sektor at industriya. Muli, pinapanawagan natin, at nanggaling din kanina ang Office of the President, gamitin ang emergency powers para suspendihin o bawasan ang excise tax sa petroleum products.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dito sa Kongresong ito, busisiin na tanggalin ang excise taxes sa petroleum products at aralin ang pagbabasura sa value-added tax sa langis. Ngayon naman po tungkol sa trabaho ng National Electrification Administration. Habang pinoproblema ang mataas na singil sa kuryente, may halos tatlong milyong Filipino households pa ang wala pa ring access sa kuryente.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung halos tatlong milyon ang unserved households, bakit milyon-milyong kabahayan pa rin ang walang kuryente? Maaari bang ibahagi ang profile ng natitirang unserved households at ilan ang nasa geographically isolated and disadvantaged areas?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, regarding that, we can submit detailed data to the distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Ang population po natin ay hindi kumokonti kundi lumalaki, at may budgetary constraints. That's why NEA is asking for additional funding para sa sitio electrification. Nag-aaral din ang NEA dahil ang sitios ay lumalaki at humahaba.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: When you put a sitio electrification program in one community na minimum ten houses, pag may kuryente na, lalayo na naman yung tao at papakuryentehan mo na naman sila. We have to review the electrification limitations, kasi kung hindi, baka buong kabundukan natin may linya na ng kuryente.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa plano po ba ng DOE, kailan natin maaabot ang pinakamalapit sa 100% electrification? Naintindihan ko pong malaking issue ang pagkuha ng datos sa PSA; kung tama ang pagkakatanda ko, 2018 pa ang datos na ginagamit. Ang pinakahuling datos na makakatulong sa pagpopondo at pagpaplano ay hindi pa natin nakikita.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sinabi ninyong kailangan ng mas malaking pondo at suporta, pero may malaking challenges pa sa pag-abot ng 100%. Ano sa ngayon ang ating mga plano?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: This may not be accurate, Mr. Speaker, kasi lumalaki ang population. But based on the population now, kung ito ang ating kokuryentehan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: we need 67 billion and it will be done by 2033.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, ang access sa reliable at abot kaya na kuryente napakahalaga sa pag-aaral, sa edukasyon, sa kabuhayan, sa kalusugan, sa komunikasyon ng bawat pamilyang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kailangan maabot ang mga communities na nananatiling underserved at unserved, lalong-lalo na sa mga malalayong lugar na matagal nang naghihintay ng access sa servisyo na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dapat po natin tiyakin na ang kuryente ay abot kaya maasaan at tuloy-tuloy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya po, dito rin sa Kongreso, bubusisiin po natin marami pong mga panukala ngayon na may kinalaman tungkol dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman tungkol sa gasoline station training and loan funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ayon sa COA, may 81.3 million pesos na accumulated amount sa ilalim ng gasoline station training and loan fund o GSTLF as of December 31, 2024.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ito ay bahagi ng 300 million fund na manggagaling sa PAGPOR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ito po ay ayon sa Republic Act No. 8479.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At ayon din sa COA, 14 years na ang nakalipas pero hindi pa rin nagagamit o underutilized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang pondong ito dahil walang gustong mag-loan sa hirap ng mga rekesitos nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kasama sa recommendations ng COA na maglabas ang DOE ng Department Circular para amyendahan ng guidelines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron na po bang nagawa ang DOE tungkol sa pagre-review ng guidelines sa paggamit ng pondo na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker. As of now kasi wala pong nag-apply but the DOE will amplify.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Siguro po mas malaman po na ating mga taong bayan na meron ganitong programa para po mag-apply po sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, malinaw po yung observation tsaka yung recommendation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi lang po ito tungkol sa awareness. Maaaring factor yung awareness, yung kakulangan ng information.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Tungkol sa paggamit at application ng Gasoline Station Training and Loan Funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero ang sinabi po dito sa particular ay yung hirap ng mga requirements, ng mga rekesitos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya maaari ba ang pag-aralan ng DOE?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Agad, huwag na po tayo makintay hanggang sa susunod pa na taon para ma-review ang guidelines tungkol sa application nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, Mr. Speaker, nais ko lang din po na maidagdag na ang layunin naman,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: nitong GSTLF ayon sa oil deregulation law ay ma-promote at ma-encourage ang active at direct participation ng private sector at cooperatives

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa retailing ng petroleum products sa pamamagitan ng mga joint venture supply agreements sa mga industry participants para po sa establishment ng gasoline stations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero sa kasalukuyan na kalagayan na ilang mga major oil players lamang ang nandyan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Siguro talagang mangangahas na dumaan dun sa napakahirap na proseso para lang mangutang sa GSTLF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nakuha na po natin yung commitment ng ating sponsor, ng departamento, at aabangan po natin yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil hindi lang po ito tungkol sa pag-review mismo ng guidelines ng circular, pero tungkol din ito sa pagsasabansa mismo ng industriya ng lanis

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para gawin sanang sentralisado ang procurement ng mga produktong petrolyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: may iwasan ang price manipulation para sa mas mabilis at direkta na pagbibigay ng subsidyo sa panahon ngayon ng krisis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman po tungkol sa proposed oil storage facility ng Abu Dhabi National Oil Company at Saudi Aramco para sa itatayong commercial facility dito sa Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maari po bang mag-update sa atin ang ating distinguished sponsor kung ano po ang status ng planong storage facility?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Na ito ng ADNOC at Saudi Aramco.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, 50 million barrels ang target nila, 500 hectares po ang kailangan para dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At abate po sa balita sa Zamboanga po ang nakikitang lupa na pwedeng pagtayuan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, it's Zamboanga and even Bataan, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: And as of now, nag-uusap na po with PNOC regarding this matter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, nandito pa rin po tayo sa pag-aaral.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, wala pa pong definite na since nag-aaral pa lang po tayo, so hindi po natin pwedeng sagutin ng mas accurate or mas defined yung inyong katanungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But on process na po yung pag-uusap with PNOC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, nag-uusap pa lang po ang DOE at ang mga nabanggit ng mga kumpanya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pinag-aaralan pa lang po ng DOE ang proposals?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At may kasama pa po ba tayo, ibang agencies?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But yung commitment po is by 2028.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nakita po kasi natin sa balita ang target.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: So, pinabalita niyo po ngayon nasa one million lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Bukod po ba sa PNOC, meron pa po ba tayong ibang mga kausap na agencies ng ating pamahalaan

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Halimbawa po, natanong ko ito kasi sa pag-identify natin ng location.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Halimbawa, kung meron pong mga nakatira doon

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: o kaya naman ay ginagamit para sa agensya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Meron na po ba sa ngayon na coordination with other agencies

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: As of now, wala pa naman pong defined talaga kung saan po mismo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But yung specific location, hindi pa po yun na pa-finalize.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But definitely, PNOC po kasi iba naman po yung mandato po nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But they have to coordinate siguro po with DAR, with DNR, other government agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But we have to assure na hindi po mawawalan ng bahay

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: o ang ating pong mga constituents na pwedeng apektoan ng pagtatayang po ng ating planta.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At patuloy naman natin na susubay ba yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Diba ng ating kapulungan, ang pagtitiyak, halimbawa, na sangayon sa ating mga batas,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na sangayon sa mga existing po natin ng mga palisya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: hinggil sa proteksyon, halimbawa, sa agrikultura, sa kalikasan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang kung anuman na itatayo ng mga bagong storage facility.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman po, yung nabanggit nyo po kanina na Bataan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ito po ba yung 15 million barrel reserve sites sa Bataan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, doon po tayo mag-uumpisa ng project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: But, regarding yung specific na 15 million?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Well, hindi po sa Bataan lang yan, it can be spread all over the country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, not specifically 15 million po for Bataan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Okay, sa ngayon po ba meron na kayong pag-aaral o maaring maibahagi sa kapulungan na ito at sa publiko

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na kung matutuloy ang particular na proyekto na ito ng PNOC?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kasi, ay ilang araw, linggo o buwan ang itatagal ng oil reserve na mailalagak sa site na yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: One million barrels, it's only about two to three days, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, a distinguished sponsor, yan po ang dahilan kung bakit sa tinpo natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: bagamat marami po tayong mga pagsisikap para matiyak na may mga dagdag tayo na facilities para sa storage,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Patiyak na magkakaroon tayo ng oil reserve, hindi po asapat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kinakailangan pa rin na pag-aaralan po natin paano ba magkakaroon ng mas matibay at matatag na centralized procurement system.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At yung pag-aaral natin dito sa Kongreso tungkol sa pagsasabansa ng industriya ng lanis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Patagal na po sinusulong ng Gabriela Women's Party kasama po ang mga partylist sa ilalim po ng makabayan koalasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang House Bill No. 8125 o ang Downstream Oil Industry Regulation Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nandiyan din po ang House Bill No. 8126, ang Centralized Petroleum Procurement Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nandiyan din po ang bill tungkol din sa renationalization ng Petron.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: So yan lang po yung ilan dun sa mga panukala na amienda kasabay din nung unbundling ng oil prices.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Isa pa po yan, yung pagtitiyak din ng transparency sa mga singil at pagpapababa ng singil sa landas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Langis ganun din po sa kuryente.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya po, sana ang mga panukalang batas na ito ay agaran na matalakay dito sa Kongreso

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: upang maiwasan po natin ang malakartel na gawi ng mga malalaking players

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na madalas po ay lubos-lubos ang pagkita mula sa ordinaryong mamamayan

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: habang nakikita po natin na yung kita nila ay lubos na paghihirap sa ordinaryong mamamayan Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Naway, mapalakas po natin ang industriyalang langis para sa mga ordinaryong Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming maraming salamat, Ginong Speaker, Mr. Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: Thank you, Honorable Ilago, Majority Leader.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ryan S. Recto
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move to recognize the Honorable Tino from the ACT Teachers Party List to interpolate the sponsor.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano
segments.text: The Honorable Antonio Tino of ACT Party List is recognized. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Magandang hapon. Thank you, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Well, una, yung kasalukuyang energy emergency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Of course, alam natin, unang nadeklara ito earlier in the year dahil sa gera ng USA-Iran beginning of March onwards.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tapos, tumaas ang presyo ng gasolina at diesel, LPG, lahat na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ngayon, at the height of that crisis, bumili po ng diesel, direct procurement ng diesel at LPG,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang, well, Department of Energy, ang gobyerno ng Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ayon sa mga datos na binigay sa atin, bumili po ng 21,000 liters,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And also, diesel and gasoline amounting to 268,180,012 liters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, kakamustahin po natin kung ano na ang status ng mga ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ayon po sa inyong datos, yung 21,000 liters of LPG

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: alos, mahigit, kumulang kalahati po nito ay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ay wala na or committed na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Either, well, iklaro natin, binenta ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: But, according to your data, of the 21,000 liters,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 11,000 liters na lamang ang nasa storage as of August 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ano po nangyari dun sa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: more or less, half of the purchased LPG?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Regarding the LPG, yung 21,000 na binagay niyo po, ay nabenta na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: At karamihan po ang bumili is mga LPG players.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ano po ang nangyari dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: pag-stabilize o pagbaba ng presyo ng LPG?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: How much was it sold for?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: O pwede pong ipaliwanag kung paano ang nangyari?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano po ang masasabing efekto nito

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay, so in an effort to stabilize,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: As of August, ito po yung report nyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: As of August, it's only middle of September.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: How about the diesel and gasoline purchases?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, high-profile po itong mga purchases na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Some of them, if I'm not mistaken,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ayon sa datos na sinubmit nyo, tapos ngayon, 181.7 thousand liters in storage.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Correct, Mr. Speaker, but I would like to clarify, wala po tayong binili sa Russia.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, okay. Wala pong binili sa Russia.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Thank you for that clarification. So, saan po binili? More or less, ah...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sige, walang binili sa Russia. Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, may 181.7 thousand liters still in storage as of your submission, August.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ganun pa rin po ba? This is still in storage?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, you are correct, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: More or less. And this is diesel and gasoline. Tama po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Ngayon, tinatanong po natin, anong nangyari doon sa more or less 80... roughly 80 thousand liters. What happened to that?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Meron po kayong report that 6.4 million liters were sold to PNOCEC for off-grid SPAG power generation at a preferential...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yes. Yan po yung datos na sinabit nyo. So, in other words, nakabili kayo ng diesel. At that time, mataas pa yung presyo nun. That was over a hundred. Tapos, binenta nyo at a preferential rate. So, mas mura. 80 pesos per liter para dun sa missionary areas na gumagamit ng diesel generators.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, presumably, nakatulong sa pagpapababa o pag-maintain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Nung mas mababang presyo ng kuryente. Okay. Ano po nangyari doon sa iba pa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: It was sold to the traders, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: No, kasi 6.4 million lamang yung binenta sa PNOCEC for off-grid.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, meron pang natitira po na more than 80 thousand liters na...

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes. Binenta rin po yan sa mga oil companies. Especially yung mga nakikigamit po tayo ng mga facilities po nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Kasi wala po tayong facility. So, dun po napunta yung pagbenta po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, binenta sa oil companies at a preferential rate of 80 pesos per liter? Is that it?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: No. At o, yun po. Pwedeng magpaliwanag po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Actually, there's a formula. Yung pagbenta based on...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, so based on the prevailing MOPs price.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yung sa NAPOCOR and sa oil companies, magkaiba po yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. So, mula nung pumasok po ito in several shipments, ay binibenta nyo na po sa private companies. Ganun po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, what is... Pwedeng paki-explain. What was the policy? How is this... How did the DOE dispose of this... At least a portion of this purchase, direct purchase by government?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Naintindihan natin. Sige, pagbenta tayo sa PNOCEC para sa missionary electrification.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero, paano po yung sa private companies? What is the policy there?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Sir, first, ah, Mr. Speaker, may supply po tayo. Okay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Regarding the policy on pagbenta po sa private, we follow the Singapore MOPs price.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Hindi po kasi pwedeng specific kasi iba-iba po yung nangyayari. Like, every week, every day, nag-iba po yan. World market, nag-iba yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: So, ang ginawa lang po talaga ng ating government is to make sure na may supply po tayo ng diesel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Lalo na kung wala tayong supply ng diesel, mas problema po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero, para po, paano po nakatiyak ang gobyerno at ang DOE na yung binenta sa private ay nag-translate sa mas mababang presyo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Baka mamaya, pinatungan din nila, di lugi ang taong bayan, ang taxpayer at ang consumer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes. Actually, Mr. Speaker, ang pagbenta po ng DOE o ng PNOC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Sa ating mga oil players, depende pa rin sa market price. So, yun din po yung sinusunod natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. So, market price. So, hindi necessarily naka-resulta sa pagbaba ng presyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Well, hindi po ba pwede? Bakit hindi po ginawa? Alam ko pinag-uusapan nyo noon, bakit hindi ginawa na direct ang ibenta ng DOE at a lower rate yung diesel?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: We truly understand that, Mr. Speaker. But there are also restrictions within DOE, lalo na po sa COA. So, wala po sa mandato ng DOE na magbenta po ng…

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, sinasabi nyo po, nakatali ang kamay ng DOE, hindi pwede yung direct… some arrangement where this diesel and gasoline may be sold at a preferential rate, at a lower rate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: To the consumers. So, yung po sinasabi nyo. Or, di kaya, through the… yung fuel subsidy program, hindi po ba pwede yun?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Actually, fuel subsidy, we can do it. But it's not really the DOE's doing it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: The DOTr po yung nag-implement po noon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ano po ang plano ng DOE sa 181 million liters in storage?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Diesel and gasoline. Ganun din lang po. Benta pa rin sa pribadong sektor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes. Yung 181, we have to dispose it in a calibrated way, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: We have to be very prudent. We have to study it. Hindi po basta ang ididispose mo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: We have to study also the situation, not only in the Philippines, but the world market.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Pero ang masiguro lang po natin na hindi po maubusan ng supply ng diesel ang Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: May lugi na po dyan. Dahil ito, binili ito, nasa mga 120, 150 pesos per liter ang diesel at the time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: E ngayon, hindi pa naman. Umaabot. Pero hindi pa lumalag pa sa, I think, 100 pesos per liter ang diesel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, definitely, kung ibenta mo ngayon ito, definitely may lugi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kaya nga po, dapat maingat na we don't, hindi natin gustong i-subsidize yung tubo ng,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ng, ah, gobyerno or malugi ang gobyerno unnecessarily. Diba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Yes, you are absolutely correct, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Anyway, so, binabantayan po natin ang mangyayari dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, ngayon, since we're on the topic, ah, ano po, I mean, at ayon sa mga, ah, analyst, ay mukhang tatagal pa yung crisis sa supply

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: With, ah, still the problem in the Strait of Hormuz. Diba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, tumataas na naman muli ang presyo, lalo na, specifically of diesel, not just because of the supply, but issues with refining capacity globally.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: No? Ah, it's also the war in Iraq, ah, sorry, the war in Ukraine. Diba? The Ukraine war, ah, which has resulted in destruction of, ah, refining capacity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: In, ah, Russia, among others. Yung Iran war naman, ah, may epekto sa refining capacity, obviously, in the Gulf states. And Iran itself. Okay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, so, mukhang tatagal pa to. Ah, ano po ang kakayahan ngayon ng, ah, DOE at ng gobyerno para magpatuloy sa mga, ah, safety net or mitigating measures?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: May sapat na pondo pa po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang DOE, ah, o ang administrasyon in general, alam ko bahagi naman ng DOE sa pagpaplano dyan, ah, para matugunan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Paano kung pumalo muli tayo sa more than 100 pesos per, per liter na diesel na hindi malayong mangyari yan? No? In the near future.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: I agree, Mr. Speaker, but, ah, ang DOE po is policymaking body, but at the end of the day, executive decision po yan. What we can do is make recommendations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: We can make studies. Ah, we can recommend to the DBCC, but at the end of the day, ah, economic managers po ang mag-de-decide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Now, as to the storage, so, meron kayong, ah, 181.7 liters in storage in several facilities. Ah, tama po ba isa sa mga pinakamalaking facilities for storage is the one in Subic? Is that correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yung facility na yun sa Subic is that the Philippine Coastal Storage, ah, facility in Subic. That is the single largest fuel storage facility in the country, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At ginagamit po ba ito ng DOE para sa kanilang, ayun, yung binanggit natin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: How much of the 181 million liters is there?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Ah, in barrels, we have, ah, about 900, 8,000 to 900,000 barrels, ah, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. So, hindi lang yung, ah, yung, yung purchase kung hindi more than that? Parang ganun po ba? Okay. Ah...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Um, barrels po, ah, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, 159 million liters. Is that correct?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: No, 159 per barrel. So, compute ka nga. More or less, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, barrel. Barrel. Oh, you're using barrels. Oh, I get it. Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: O, sige po. Anyway, so ginagamit. Pero ang isang issue po dito, of course, this is privately owned.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And currently, the majority owner of that is, in fact, the U.S. investment firm, I-Squared.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Wala po ba kayong nakikitang issues that a significant part of the country's, ah, very limited strategic reserve is, ah, in a facility actually owned by a foreign corporation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Well, as of now, ah, we have no choice. That's why ang recommendation po ng DOE is magtayo po ng sarili.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnie B. Fuentebella
segments.text: Because, ah, we are also paying rent.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And is it not also true that the, ah, that facility...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: The Philippine Coastal Storage Facility in Stubic, ah, also, ah, holds, ah, the Navy, ah, the fuel reserves of the U.S. Navy?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
